# LoanOS India

> LoanOS India is an India-first, multi-tenant lending lifecycle SaaS platform for regulated financial institutions and their authorised partners. LoanOS is technology; it does not lend directly.

## Core platform

- [Platform overview](https://loanos.in/platform/): loan origination, loan management, human workflow, compliance controls and human-governed AI.
- [Financial institutions](https://loanos.in/financial-institutions/): the operating model for banks, NBFCs, HFCs and other regulated lenders.
- [Lending partners](https://loanos.in/partners/): scoped participation for LSPs, DLAs, fintechs, DSAs, co-lenders and service providers.
- [Borrower experience](https://loanos.in/for-msmes/): the customer journey from application through servicing and closure.
- [Loan journeys](https://loanos.in/loan-types/): configurable business, retail, secured, asset, trade and specialised lending patterns.
- [Trust centre](https://loanos.in/trust/): tenant isolation, evidence, India boundaries, customer protection and human-governed AI.
- [Resources](https://loanos.in/resources/): buyer questions, FAQs and a plain-language lending glossary.

## Important boundaries

- LoanOS is India-only and INR-first.
- The regulated entity remains accountable for its products, policies, decisions, partners and customers.
- Product and integration readiness depends on institutional configuration, deployment, review and live-provider validation.
- LoanOS does not claim that use of the platform alone makes a lender compliant.
